acquisition_method.evidence: Eluting peptides were sprayed at a voltage of 2.1 kV and acquired in a MS data-dependent mode using Xcalibur software (version 2.2, Thermo Scientific).

alkylation_reagent.evidence: modifications: monohydroxylated residue; acetylated residue; iodoacetamide derivatized residue

cleavage_agent.evidence: Approximately 100 µg protein, applied to Vivacon filters (30K MWKO, Sartorius, Germany), was subjected to digestion with trypsin using the FASP protocol.

collision_energy.evidence: Up to ten of the most abundant ions were subjected to fragmentation by higher energy collisional dissociation (HCD) with a normalized collision energy of 27%.

fragmentation_method.evidence: Up to ten of the most abundant ions were subjected to fragmentation by higher energy collisional dissociation (HCD) with a normalized collision energy of 27%.

ionization_type.evidence: Analysis of peptide mixtures was performed on an Ultimate 3000 nano LC and Q Exactive mass spectrometer system coupled to a FLEX nano-electrospray ion source (all components were from Thermo Scientific).

labeling.evidence: Both the label-free quantitation (LFQ) and the intensity-based absolute quantitation (iBAQ) tools were enabled.

mass_analyzer.evidence: inferred: The full scan MS spectra were acquired at a resolution of 70,000 over a mass range of m/z 250 to 1,800 with an automatic gain control (AGC) target of 106.
